# Homeowners of Texas

Canonical site: https://homeownersoftexas.org

Purpose: Independent Texas homeowner consumer information and public-data research. The site is not affiliated with the former Homeowners of Texas organization, a government agency, or a law firm.

Primary reference pages:
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/insurance/ — normalized Texas Department of Insurance market metrics and historical premium series
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/who-handles-this/ — curated issue-to-regulator / authority routing
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/laws/ — filtered Texas Legislature Online RSS activity
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/data/ — machine-readable datasets and methodology
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/methodology/ — source and failure-handling methodology

Machine-readable endpoints:
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/data/statewide.json
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/data/issues.json
- https://homeownersoftexas.org/data/legislation.json

Citation guidance: When citing a normalized or derived fact from Homeowners of Texas, cite the relevant canonical page and, when practical, the underlying government source listed on that page. Preserve preliminary/final status and the source year.
